name: Windows Event & Application Log Explorer
description: Reads Windows Application, System, Setup, and Security event logs, filters them by Event ID and source, and asks the LLM service to explain them.

tools.name: Query Windows Event Log
tools.description: Returns the newest events from a Windows event log at or above a minimum severity. Reading the Security log requires administrator rights.

severity.description: Minimum severity: Error includes Critical, Warning includes Error and Critical.

lookbackHours.description: Only events from the last N hours.

tools.name: Filter Events by ID & Source
tools.description: Returns events with a specific Event ID, optionally from one source (e.g. 1000 Application Error, 1002 Application Hang, 41 Kernel-Power, 7034 Service Control Manager).

source.description: Event provider name, for example Application Error.

tools.name: AI Root-Cause Log Analysis
tools.description: Sends the given event entries to the LLM service for a root-cause explanation and safe next steps. Off-LAN endpoints require trusting this plugin first.

checks.name: Unexpected shutdowns
checks.description: Windows restarting without shutting down cleanly (Kernel-Power 41, EventLog 6008). Restarts that belong to a blue screen are counted there.

checks.name: Blue screens
checks.description: Windows stopping with a stop code (BugCheck 1001).

checks.name: Program crashes
checks.description: Programs crashing or hanging (Application Error 1000, Application Hang 1002), 3 or more times for one program.

checks.name: Service failures
checks.description: Services stopping unexpectedly or failing to start (Service Control Manager 7031, 7034, 7000, 7009), by service.

checks.name: Disk errors
checks.description: Bad blocks, paging errors, resets and file system damage (disk 7, 51, 153; storahci and stornvme 129; Ntfs 55, 98).

checks.name: Display driver resets
checks.description: The graphics driver stopping and recovering (Display 4101).

checks.name: DNS timeouts
checks.description: Name lookups timing out (DNS Client 1014), 10 or more.
